steps.what: Read the applicable current nuclear-equipment procedure and environmental constraints
Follow the actual equipment procedure and observe environmental-safety conditions
Complete the procedure's existing required check entries

tasks.design: Keep environmental-safety procedure execution and its existing required check entries human. The native controlled procedure in {DOCS} already supplies the check structure; actual observations and applicability reading still require the technician, so no additional automation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The remaining work is performing and verifying the procedure rather than reformatting it.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled documents provide the relevant native checklist support.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising abnormal equipment conditions and following the actual site procedure.
tasks.human_edge: Connect physical observations with the procedure's limits and required response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled nuclear equipment procedures can include performed-check entries; a prefilled structure does not establish that checks occurred.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a procedure that actually requires a performed-check sheet read by operations supervision. No new generic activity log is created; procedures without such entries remove and reweight s3.

Procedure control supplies the current revision and required check items before s1. s2 produces actual observations; s3 records those facts manually. No pre-existing structured observation or automatic confirmation is assumed.

The record write is separated before assigning zero. Native checklist structure is assessed and already present; only fresh actual check facts remain to enter. No established duplicate re-key or repeated formatting is available to remove.

Ordinary checklist save is retained without an author approval stage. Existing automatic equipment logs and runtime earn no labour saving. Actual separately assigned formal releases or messages must be added with their own final-version checks before extending this boundary.
No implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Exact check entries required by the applicable procedure
Any actual duplicate reporting beyond the controlled checklist
research_questions: Observe a real procedure and verify that any record, lookup or send is separately counted before confirming zero.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 instruction-reading, 80 actual procedure and 10 fresh check-entry points. A procedure with more abnormal conditions adds human work rather than a template saving. No additional administration is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor reactor performance for inefficiency or maintenance needs

steps.what: Observe reactor equipment performance and select verified historical readings
Assemble repeated trend comparisons from selected recorded readings
Interpret trends and investigate actual hazards or maintenance needs
Write and check the existing shift-log findings for operations follow-up

tasks.design: First test native historian trend views in the operations environment represented by {OPS_SYSTEM}; if needed, assemble only read-only exported histories into repeated comparison tables. Keep continuous observation, investigation and the existing shift-log finding human, with no connection from the reporting change to reactor controls or protective functions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated historical trend assembly may be manual outside existing live displays.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historical views or deterministic read-only table assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing sensor issues, inefficiency and actual hazardous conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret trends against real equipment behaviour and operational context.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated trend assembly, with operational authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: read-only historian views can assemble recorded trends without diagnosing reactor conditions or changing control functions.

assumptions: Provisional shares concern performance monitoring and the existing shift log used by operations and maintenance. No new daily report is introduced. Existing live alarms, historian recording and computational runtime earn no saving.

Instrument systems produce tag, time, value, units and status histories. s1 verifies tag mapping, selects intervals and defines the comparison specification; missing or suspect readings require human investigation in s1/s3.

Test native views first. s2 removes actual repeated manual assembly only, not continuous monitoring, alarm interpretation or engineering diagnosis. Unsupported histories remain manually assembled within retained work or require a reduced estimate.

s4 is the actual findings write and complete check, fully retained with an ordinary ungated save. Any real corrective instruction or operational change remains a separately authorised action under existing site procedures.
unknowns: Actual manual assembly outside historian views
Compatibility and quality of tag histories
research_questions: Which repeated trend assembly remains after existing displays and runtime are excluded?

incremental.description: Maintain read-only history mappings and trend-output checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 manual-assembly points less 1.5 upkeep gives 18.5. A changed instrument set with inconsistent history units leaves only 5 points of compatible trend assembly removable; retain all mapping repair, monitoring and diagnosis, giving 3.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read applicable radiation-worker instructions and current access conditions
Follow actual personnel-safety procedures and observe worker conditions
Read actual dosimetry and access records and resolve discrepancies through existing arrangements

tasks.design: Retain actual radiation-worker compliance and the separately counted record reading. The existing dosimetry and access module in {OPS_SYSTEM} already records device events; a native view supports the technician without removing the need to verify and resolve discrepancies.
tasks.previous_blocker: The remaining work is physical compliance and personal interpretation, not duplicate data capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native access and dosimetry views provide recorded information.
tasks.still_hard: Correctly applying site-specific requirements and recognising an unexplained discrepancy.
tasks.human_edge: Relate personal and physical observations to the recorded facts.
tasks.altitude: No change to worker responsibilities or access authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: worker dosimetry and access records can already be produced by existing systems; their runtime is not a technician transcription baseline.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover personal radiation-worker compliance, including actual dosimetry/access record reading. Radiation-protection specialists' administration is not focal labour.

The existing dosimetry/access system produces person reference, date, recorded reading and status from its established process. s3 verifies correspondence; absent readings require existing human follow-up, never generated replacement values.

Before zero, record/write/send boundaries were considered. This scenario has automatic source recording and a separate human read/check; no new personal activity log or manual dose re-entry is invented. If the technician actually owns a required written discrepancy report, add that observed write and assess the native form before confirming zero.
Native record views are assessed first and already supply the relevant fields. Full reading and discrepancy resolution remain. Existing recording runtime earns no saving.
No new implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Any real re-entry into separate required records
research_questions: Observe the worker procedure and separate any actual required write or send from the counted record reading.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 10 instruction, 80 physical-compliance and 10 record-check points remain. An unexplained dose record requires more human investigation, not a shared formula or a fictional log saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor experimental instruments under experimenter direction

steps.what: Monitor actual instruments, gauges and recording devices under the experimenter's direction
Enter protocol-required observations into the existing experiment log
Check the log and discuss actual findings with the experimenter

tasks.design: Use native experiment/run defaults in the experimental data-acquisition environment represented by {OTHER} for the existing protocol-required observation log. Keep instrument monitoring, all fresh observation entry, full correspondence checking and discussion with the experimenter human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Run and instrument references can be repeated while entering observations not captured automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unexpected instrument behaviour and following the experimenter's actual instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Notice physical or contextual anomalies that recorded values alone miss.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated run-reference entry, with experimental responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: run-linked experimental log forms can retain stable references while fresh instrument observations still require actual capture.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe an experiment whose existing protocol requires a technician observation log used by the experimenter. No new standalone monitoring report is created; remove and reweight s2 if recording is wholly automatic.

The experimenter supplies protocol, run identifier and instrument list before s1. s1 captures actual unrecorded observations. s2 counts entering those facts; missing run references require manual clarification.

Try native run defaults first. Three removed points are repeated run/instrument reference entry only; observation values, validation, discussion and the ordinary ungated save remain. Device-recording runtime earns no labour saving.
s3 contains only full log checking and live discussion, not an uncounted record write or electronic send. Any separate formal report belongs in its own assessed boundary.
unknowns: Which observations actually require manual entry
Whether run references already populate the experiment log
research_questions: Does the protocol's current log require repeated run references beyond actual observation entry?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 times 15%=3 run-reference points less 0.7 upkeep gives 2.3. A one-off experiment needs manual instrument and protocol references, leaving only 0.8 point of stable run identifier reuse and 0.1 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep physical monitoring, procedure compliance and nuclear judgement human while removing only verified manual trend assembly or repeated experiment references.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish automatic device records from manual observations
role.ambitious_version: Use verified recovered interaction time for closer observation, without extending operational authority.
